text:
Iris: quick check 1: proposing we move the 'Preview recent alerts' trigger inline under channel chips instead of the footer so it stays visible when suppression is toggled. anyone worried about density or keyboard flow? :eyes:
Omar: sounds good. main constraint is row density in lists. recommend a micro-link (text + icon) for compact rows to avoid bumping height.
Neha: agree micro-link. keyboard order must stay logical: channels -> suppression -> preview. that way keyboard users can toggle suppression and preview the updated results without extra tabs.
Gary: copy nit 1: "Preview recent alerts" is clear but long for the compact variant. propose compact text "Preview" with tooltip "Preview recent alerts for selected channels".
Iris: fine with that. also want the preview CTA to surface whether suppressed channels are included. small muted icon + tooltip "Includes suppressed channels" when suppression on.
Accessibility Bot: suggestion: add aria-label="Preview recent alerts for selected channels" on the trigger; include aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded when open. ensure preview panel updates an aria-live="polite" region with result count.
Omar: implementation note: lazy-load preview data on click for compact lists; cache last preview per rule for 30s. show a tiny cached badge in the flyout header when using cached data.
Neha: focus behavior: if preview opens as popover don't trap focus; shift focus to the panel then restore to trigger on close. if modal, trap focus. add focus-visible styles.
Gary: analytics: emit event with shape like: preview_open(rule_id, channels, suppressed=true|false, variant=compact|panel, cached=true|false, result_count=INT). keep it small.
Iris: hotkey idea: offer a one-key shortcut 'P' but only after the user has used preview once. show a transient hint "Press P to open preview" after first successful open. opt-out via settings.
Accessibility Bot: keyboard shortcut note: ensure the shortcut doesn't conflict with other global shortcuts; announce availability via a non-intrusive toast and include the hint in the accessible help menu.
Omar: color/accessibility: inline link token must meet AA for small text. if we keep 12px use stronger token or bump to 14px. also ensure focus ring contrast >=3:1.
Neha: UX edge: when suppression causes zero results show a clear message in the preview: "No recent alerts (suppressed)" and a link "Show suppressed sends" that toggles suppression in context. keep that link reachable by keyboard.
Gary: dev note: for compact view we should keep the payload small (ids + timestamps + short message) and avoid loading full event bodies. full panel can fetch details on demand.
Iris: sounds like consensus. I'll update Figma with compact/expanded variants, add the muted icon state, and include the hotkey hint behavior. I'll also add a checklist item to PRs: tab order, focus restore, color contrast, aria-live checks.
Accessibility Bot: checklist addition: ensure aria-live region announces changes and that the trigger has an accessible name separating channel scope: e.g., "Preview recent alerts for X channels".
Omar: I'll prototype the micro-link + cached badge in storybook and add keyboard tests.
Neha: I'll write the copy variants and tooltips.
Gary: I'll add telemetry mapping to the analytics spec and implement the lazy-load/caching behavior.
Iris: thanks team 1: will drop links in the design PR and flag for keyboard QA. :white_check_mark:
